draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.19, the 2nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 11 at TE. He went 4th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Darren Waller. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (99th percentile), broad jump (94th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 1st in receiving yards among the 10 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 78 career games and 72 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 8 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 87.7% (99th percentile), team target share 22.7% (98th percentile), receiving yards 928 (97th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 tight end who played: 928 receiving yards against a median of 193, above the norm.
